sections.title: Overview
descriptions: In his May 13, 2025 complaint-findings letter, Chief Cameron Paul concluded that Officer Zachary P. Goodale violated department policy and state law, including by parking unlawfully in an accessible parking space. Paul said Goodale should not have issued Gregory Hazard a trespass order, rescinded the order, and apologized on behalf of the department and city.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Zachary P. Goodale worked for the American Fork Police Department from June 10, 2019 to January 13, 2025.
